displayName: Peptide Therapy & BHRT Patient Education Bundle
description: Clinically written patient education materials for med spas and wellness practices offering peptide therapy and bioidentical hormone replacement therapy (BHRT). Covers what peptides are, how BHRT works, patient intake, informed consent, and self-injection training guides. Written by a licensed esthetician and RN student with real clinical experience.
targetBuyer: Med spas, functional medicine clinics, and wellness practices offering peptide therapy or BHRT programs

templates.name: What Are Peptides? Patient Education Guide
templates.description: Plain-language explainer covering how peptides work, popular peptides (BPC-157, Sermorelin, Ipamorelin, CJC-1295), and what to expect — written for patients, not providers

templates.name: Understanding BHRT: A Patient's Guide
templates.description: BHRT overview covering hormone testing, pellet vs cream vs injection delivery, symptom timelines, and what labs to monitor

templates.name: Peptide & Hormone Therapy Intake Form
templates.description: Comprehensive health history for peptide and hormone patients — symptoms checklist, goals, prior treatment history, and current medications

templates.name: Peptide Therapy Informed Consent Form
templates.description: Consent covering off-label use disclosure, expected outcomes, risks, self-administration responsibilities, and lab monitoring requirements

templates.name: Self-Injection Training Guide
templates.description: Step-by-step illustrated guide for patients self-administering subcutaneous peptide injections — site rotation, needle disposal, and storage

templates.name: Monthly Symptom & Progress Tracker
templates.description: Month-by-month tracking log for energy, sleep, mood, libido, body composition, and side effects — supports provider follow-up conversations

templates.name: Peptide Therapy FAQ Card
templates.description: Double-sided quick-reference card answering the 10 most common patient questions about peptide storage, dosing schedules, and what to do if they miss a dose

deliveryNote: All templates open in Canva as your own editable copy. Written from real clinical experience — customize with your clinic name, provider credentials, and any program-specific protocols. Recommend medical director review of all consent forms prior to patient use.
